title: 第十一章：少年人的引路者——老羊皮
content_zh:
如果说部族里漂亮的小姑娘总是属于可汗，那么，部族里面最好的小伙子就属于少年人的引路者——老羊皮。
每当歌姬用雪白纤细的手指拨动箜篌的时候，每当游吟歌者唱起《乌古斯传》赞颂回纥人的祖先的时候，在部族最勇猛的少年身边，就会出现一个身材矮小的老者。
“你是一只雄鹰，该到离开巢穴振翅飞翔的时候了，小小的部落容不下你这样的英雄。”
“你是我见过的少年人中最具有智慧的一个，赶紧离开这个主动会让你污秽一生的泥沼地，我将追随，帮助你，成就乌古斯王一样的伟大功绩。”
“你是一个真正的武士，而一个真正的武士就不该去睡大尾巴羊，离开这里，我带你去寻找草原上最美的女人，引导你的手去抚摸那些滑腻温暖而又雪白的身体，只有当你在她们身上驰骋的时候，你才会觉得你是一个真正的武士。”
“啊，年轻的回纥人啊，你怎么能够忍受日复一日，夜复一夜的放羊生活呢？
你应该骑上马，带领数不尽的武士去战场上寻找属于你的荣光，你应该成为万众瞩目的人，而不是整日里被部族里的那些旱獭一样无能的人喝骂你，殴打你，折磨你，并且羞辱你。”
“跟我走吧，你们部落里除过喝血吃肉的虱子之外什么都没有，去外边看看吧，太阳照耀的地方都是金子，你只要抵达那里，拿起你的铲子，用力，对，就是用力的铲下去，金子就属于你……”
以上，就是老羊皮专门用来针对回纥部落中所有他看得上的少年人的专用话术。
有的少年人听了一段，就急冲冲的收拾东西跟着老羊皮走了。
这样的少年人，一般会被老羊皮送去战笼碰碰运气，战死了，石国的人会给老羊皮一袋金沙，如果侥幸胜利了，老羊皮能拿到更多。
有的少年人听了两段之后就跟着老羊皮走了，很长时间过后，人们有可能在某一个王的后宫见到他，那时候的他穿着华丽的衣裳，佩戴着闪闪发光的宝石，依偎在王的怀里，扯着尖利的嗓子为来宾演唱大段大段的《乌古斯传》。
还有的人，则成了马贼……天山南北之所以会有如此多的马贼，强盗，这其中就有老羊皮奉献的力量。
云初在白羊部就像黑夜中的月光，乌云中的闪电一般的存在，老羊皮自然不会放过他。
云初八岁的时候就被老羊皮一眼看中，他想让云初跟他走，将他早就准备好的话术，翻过来覆过去的说了两遍，都不能打动云初那颗坚定的心。
如果是一般的回纥人，老羊皮也就放弃了，毕竟，如此庞大的族群里，出现一两个聪明人不是什么怪事。
但是，老羊皮却没有放弃云初，每隔一个月就会来白羊部一次，继续蛊惑云初跟他走，为此，他不惜亲自下场，教会了云初非常多的东西。
老羊皮是一个智者，他清楚，只要不断的投入，总有一天会从云初这里收获到更多的东西。
云初也是这么认为的……他觉得从老羊皮这里学到的东西对他来说非常的重要，尤其是说长安官话，用毛笔写唐人文字，学习唐人的礼仪……
通过跟随老羊皮学习，云初发现，老羊皮对大唐的了解实在不是他这个从史书上了解大唐的人能比的。

他喜欢跟着老羊皮学习。
最近，老羊皮应该忍耐不住了，事实上，三年前，老羊皮就希望云初跟他走。
现在，云初不能确定的是，老羊皮到底是要送他进战笼还是去当马贼，不过呢，从老羊皮在他身上投入来看，目标应该是——大唐。
即便如此，听到羯斯噶提起战笼遴选，云初身体都忍不住颤抖了一下，至
于娜哈则大哭起来。
石国的战笼遴选名声，在整个西域都极为有名，在石国王庭柘枝城外的药杀水河畔，永远矗立着一座，，高三米的一座巨大铁笼，铁笼上布满了杀人的铁刺。
每当有外地来的猛士敲响了铁笼旁边的铁钟，石国王庭就会派出一位勇猛的甲士进入战笼。
外地来的猛士需要进入铁笼，赤手空拳击杀石国派来的猛士，如果战胜这个猛士，他就能替代这个石国猛士成为新的石国甲士！
一旦成为石国甲士，就能获得非常多的财宝，美丽的女子，以及一座美丽的庭院。
如果失败，只有一个下场——死！
战笼遴选，对于西域武士来说，是发家最快的渠道，同时，也是距离死亡最近的道路。
这么多年以来，死在战笼里的武士数不胜数。
而死亡的人中间，十年前有六成是挑战者前，八成是挑战者，现在，据说死亡的人中间九成以上的都是挑战者。
这是一个必然的结果，估计也是石国国王招募勇士的一个策略，自家甲士的武力越来越高，能战胜自家甲士的武者的武力也必然是越来越高，最后，达到一个临界点，比如现在，已经很久没有人能挑战成功了。
所以，石国甲士是西域武力最为强悍的武士群。
一个不愿意留在原来部族的人，尤其是武士，可以选择的活命之道其实不多。
离开本来的部族，想要去别的部族活命千难万难，根本就不会获得信任。
最靠谱的一个活命方式就是去当马贼，依靠劫掠普通牧人以及商队，骆驼队活命。
一般情况下，在盗贼多如牛毛的西域，成为马贼就要做好天天打仗的准备，像云初这个年纪的少年人，根本就活不了几天就会战死，或者被同伴杀死。
另一个就是去石国参加战笼遴选，当了马贼固然是九死一生的事情，而参加战笼遴选，则是十死无生的选择。

云初一丁点挑战战笼的想法都没有！！！
他曾经受过的精密教育告诉他，挑战战笼，是最不合适他的一种发家方式。
脑子是个好东西，一个一千三百多年以后的人跑到大唐永徽二年，为了发家致富过上好日子，抛弃自己的脑子不用，偏偏要去跟人家比蛮力，这是何等愚蠢的行为啊。
“我不去柘枝城，我的目标是龟兹城！”
羯斯噶神色难明的瞅着云初低声道： “你果然要去找唐人。”
云初笑道： “有没有一种可能，我本身就是唐人？”
羯斯噶摇头道： “你不会说唐人的话，他们不会承认你是唐人的。”
云初立刻用标准的唐人官话道： “我当然会说唐人的话，不仅仅会说，我还会吟诵唐人的文章。”
羯斯噶虽然不知道云初说了一些什么，却听得清清楚楚，这就是标准的唐人的话，他当初以仆从军的身份追随唐军与薛延陀人作战的时候，听过这种话。
震惊归震惊，羯斯噶想起唐人战旗飘飘，威风凛凛，杀气腾腾的军队，还是摇摇头道： “你会说唐人的话也没有用，最多是一个会说唐人话的回纥人！”
云初笑道： “等我见过老羊皮再说。”
羯斯噶似乎不愿意跟云初说太多的话，抱起娜哈指指拴在水槽上的一匹枣红马道： “这是一匹两岁口的战马，是我从王廷给你找来的，弯刀，弓箭都给你准备好了，如果你想走，就随时走吧。”
云初弯腰致谢道： “羯斯噶，谢谢你给我准备的这些东西。”
羯斯噶摇摇头指着不知所措的塞来玛道： “你应该庆幸是塞来玛的儿子。”
云初想了一下，觉
得人家这句话似乎没有说错，就再次点头致谢道： “照顾好塞来玛跟娜哈。”
羯斯噶高傲的道： “她们从今往后将是我大阿波帐篷里的女人，谁敢伤害她们？
你如果在外边活不下去了，可以回来，我给你安排一个适合武士干的事情。”
“云……”
塞来玛想说话，不等她多说，羯斯噶就抱着哭嚎的娜哈拖着塞来玛朝他的帐篷走了。

目送他们走远，云初就来到整修好的火塘边上，煮上一锅蒲公英茶，往里面丢了几颗乌梅，静静地等待水开。
对于刚刚升官发财的羯斯噶对他的态度，云初还是接受的。
身为一只大大的拖油瓶，能被母亲的新欢如此对待，羯斯噶可以说已经做到了他能做到的一切。
水开了，蒲公英茶也就煮好了，云初端起木碗啜饮一口泛着苦涩味道的茶水，只觉得浑身通泰，有说不出来的痛快之意。
在西域十三年，最让他放不下的就是塞来玛跟娜哈，现如今，塞来玛有了新的男人，娜哈也回归到了亲生父亲的怀抱中，云初由衷的感谢羯斯噶。
眯缝着眼睛瞅瞅拴在柱子上的枣红马，云初忍不住哈哈大笑起来。
这一刻，他甚至觉得老天的安排有时候真的是非常非常的贴心。
从这一刻起，自己终于可以回归故里了，可以去那个在牧人口中宛若天堂一般的大唐去看看。

content_en:
If the beautiful little girl in the tribe always belongs to the Khan, then the best young man in the tribe belongs to the young man's guide - Lao Yangpi.
Whenever the singer plucks the harp with her slender snow-white fingers, and whenever the troubadour sings "Ogusi Biography" to praise the ancestors of the Huihe people, a short old man will appear next to the bravest young man in the tribe.
"You are an eagle. It's time to leave your nest and fly. This small tribe cannot tolerate a hero like you."
"You are the wisest young man I have ever seen. Hurry up and leave this quagmire where your initiative will ruin your life. I will follow and help you to achieve great achievements like King Ogus."
"You are a real warrior, and a real warrior should not sleep with big-tailed sheep. Leave here, and I will take you to find the most beautiful women on the grassland. I will guide your hands to touch those smooth, warm and snow-white bodies. Only when you ride on them will you feel that you are a real warrior."
"Ah, young Huihe, how can you endure the life of herding sheep day after day and night after night?
You should mount a horse and lead countless warriors to the battlefield to find your glory. You should be the center of attention, instead of being scolded, beaten, tortured, and humiliated by those incompetent people in the tribe who are as incompetent as marmots all day long. "
"Follow me. There is nothing in your tribe except lice that drink blood and eat flesh. Go outside and take a look. Wherever the sun shines, there is gold. As long as you get there, pick up your shovel, shovel it down hard, yes, shovel it down hard, and the gold will belong to you..."
The above are the special words Lao Yangpi uses to target all the young people he likes in the Uighur tribe.
After listening to a passage, some young people hurriedly packed their things and followed Lao Yangpi.
Such a young man would usually be sent to the battle cage by Lao Yangpi to try his luck. If he died in the battle, the people from the Shi Kingdom would give Lao Yangpi a bag of gold sand. If he was lucky enough to win, Lao Yangpi could get more.
Some young people followed Lao Yangpi after listening to two passages. After a long time, people may see him in a certain king's harem. At that time, he was wearing gorgeous clothes and sparkling gems, nestled in the king's arms, and sang long passages of "The Biography of Ogus" for the guests with his sharp voice.
Others have become horse thieves... The reason why there are so many horse thieves and robbers in the north and south of the Tianshan Mountains is due to the power of Lao Yangpi's dedication.
Yun Chu is like the moonlight in the dark night and lightning in the dark clouds in the Aries department. Lao Yangpi will naturally not let him go.
When Yun Chu was eight years old, he was spotted by Lao Yangpi. He wanted Yun Chu to follow him. He repeated the words he had prepared long ago over and over again, but he couldn't move Yun Chu's firm heart.
If it were an ordinary Uighur, Lao Yangpi would have given up. After all, it is not strange for one or two smart people to appear in such a large ethnic group.
However, Lao Yangpi did not give up on Yun Chu. He would come to the Aries Department every other month and continue to trick Yun Chu into following him. For this reason, he did not hesitate to go to the trouble himself and taught Yun Chu a lot of things.
Lao Yangpi is a wise man. He knows that as long as he keeps investing, he will one day gain more things from Yunchu.
Yun Chu thought so too... He felt that what he learned from Lao Yangpi was very important to him, especially speaking Chang'an Mandarin, writing Tang Chinese characters with a brush, and learning Tang people's etiquette...
By studying with Lao Yangpi, Yunchu discovered that Lao Yangpi's understanding of the Tang Dynasty was beyond what he, a person who knew about the Tang Dynasty from history books, could compare to.
He likes to learn from Lao Yangpi.
Recently, Lao Yangpi can no longer bear it. In fact, three years ago, Lao YangpiPi just hoped that Yunchu would go with him.
Now, what Yun Chu was not sure about was whether Lao Yangpi was going to send him into the fighting cage or become a horse thief. However, judging from Lao Yangpi's investment in him, the target should be - Datang.
Even so, Yunchu couldn't help but tremble when he heard Jiesiga mention the battle cage selection.
Yu Naha burst into tears.
The Shi Kingdom's reputation for war cage selection is extremely famous throughout the Western Region. On the banks of the Yaoshashui River outside Zhezhi City in the Stone Kingdom, there will always be a huge iron cage three meters high. The iron cage is covered with murderous iron thorns.
Whenever a warrior from other places rings the iron bell next to the iron cage, the Stone King's Court will send a brave warrior into the cage.
The warriors from other places need to enter the iron cage and kill the warriors sent by the Stone Kingdom with bare hands. If they defeat this warrior, he can replace the warrior from the Stone Kingdom and become the new warrior of the Stone Kingdom!
Once you become a soldier of the Stone Kingdom, you will be able to obtain a lot of treasures, beautiful women, and a beautiful courtyard.
If you fail, there is only one outcome - death!
The battle cage selection is the fastest way to make a fortune for the warriors of the Western Regions. At the same time, it is also the shortest way to death.
Over the years, countless warriors have died in battle cages.
Among those who died, 60% were Challengers ten years ago and 80% were Challengers. Now, it is said that more than 90% of those who died are Challengers.
This is an inevitable result, and it is probably also a strategy of the King of Stone Kingdom to recruit warriors. The strength of his own soldiers is getting higher and higher, and the strength of the warriors who can defeat his own soldiers must also be getting higher and higher. Finally, it reaches a critical point. For example, now, no one has been able to challenge successfully for a long time.
Therefore, the Shiguo warriors are the most powerful group of warriors in the Western Region.
A person who is unwilling to stay in his original tribe, especially a warrior, has few options for survival.
Leaving your original tribe and trying to survive in other tribes is extremely difficult, and you won't gain trust at all.
One of the most reliable ways to survive is to become a horse thief, relying on robbing ordinary shepherds, caravans, and camel caravans to survive.
Under normal circumstances, in the Western Region where there are so many thieves, becoming a horse thief means being prepared to fight every day. A young man like Yunchu's age will not survive for a few days before he will die in battle or be killed by his companions.
The other is to go to the Stone Kingdom to participate in the battle cage selection. Being a horse thief is a matter of narrow escape, but participating in the battle cage selection is a choice of no life.
Yunchu didn't even have the slightest idea of ​​challenging the cage! ! !
The precise education he had received told him that challenging the cage was the most inappropriate way for him to make a fortune.
The brain is a good thing. A person who lived more than 1,300 years later went to the second year of Yonghui in the Tang Dynasty. In order to get rich and live a good life, he abandoned his brain and chose to compete with others in terms of brute force. What a stupid behavior.
"I'm not going to Zhezhi City, my goal is Kucha City!"
Jiesga looked at Yunchu with an unclear expression and whispered: "You really want to go find the Tang people."
Yun Chu smiled and said, "Is there a possibility that I am from the Tang Dynasty?"
Jie Siga shook his head and said: "You can't speak the language of the Tang Dynasty, and they won't admit that you are from the Tang Dynasty."
Yunchu immediately said in standard Tang Dynasty Mandarin: "Of course I can speak Tang Dynasty dialect. Not only can I speak it, I can also recite Tang Dynasty articles."
Although Jiesiga didn't know what Yunchu said, he heard it clearly. This was the standard speech of the Tang Dynasty. He had heard such speech when he followed the Tang army to fight against the Xue Yantuo people as a servant army.
Shocked, Jiesiga thought of the Tang people's fluttering battle flags, majestic and murderous troops, but shook his head and said: "It's useless if you can speak the language of the Tang people. At most, you are a Uighur who can speak the language of the Tang people!"
Yun Chu smiled and said:"Wait until I see Lao Sheeppi."
Jiesiga seemed unwilling to say too much to Yunchu. He picked up Naha and pointed at a maroon horse tied to the water tank and said, "This is a two-year-old war horse. I found it for you from the royal court. I have prepared scimitars, bows and arrows for you. If you want to leave, you can leave at any time."
Yun Chu bent down and said thanks: "Jie Sika, thank you for preparing these things for me."
Jasika shook his head and pointed at Selema who was at a loss and said, "You should be lucky that you are Selema's son."
Yunchu thought for a moment and realized
Seeing that what he said was correct, he nodded his thanks again and said, "Take care of Selema and Naha."
Jiesika said arrogantly: "From now on, they will be the women in my big Abo tent. Who dares to hurt them?
If you can't survive outside, you can come back and I will arrange something suitable for a samurai to do for you. "
"Cloud..."
Selema wanted to speak, but before she could say anything more, Jiesga hugged the crying Naha and dragged Selema towards his tent.
After watching them go away, Yun Chu came to the renovated fire pit, boiled a pot of dandelion tea, threw a few black plums into it, and waited quietly for the water to boil.
Yunchu still accepted Jiesiga's attitude towards him, who had just been promoted and made a fortune.
As a big jerk, to be treated like this by his mother's new love, it can be said that Jiesga has done everything he can.
The water was boiling and the dandelion tea was ready. Yun Chu picked up the wooden bowl and took a sip of the bitter tea. He felt that his whole body was relaxed and filled with indescribable pleasure.
After thirteen years in the Western Region, the two people he couldn't let go of the most were Selema and Naha. Now, Selema has a new man, and Naha has returned to the arms of her biological father. Yunchu sincerely thanks Jiesika.
Narrowing his eyes and looking at the maroon horse tied to the pillar, Yun Chu couldn't help but laugh.
At this moment, he even felt that God's arrangements were really very considerate sometimes.
From this moment on, I can finally return to my hometown and visit the Tang Dynasty, which is like a paradise among the herdsmen.
